title: Agent Skills Manifest
description: Selection schema for the corrected product contract, confirmed 2026-10-10: a set exclusively replaces the canonical .agents/skills/ root with a symlink to the set's skill root (at most one set per scope); packs compose by adding per-skill member links to an existing canonical root. Definitions belong to all-skills/; sets and packs contain references only.

skillName.description: One canonical all-skills/ name: lowercase letters, digits, dot, dash, or underscore, beginning and ending with a letter or digit.

compositionName.description: One safe set or pack directory name, preserving the case of existing compositions.

versionComponent.description: One safe pack version directory name, including semantic-version prerelease and build suffixes.

$schema.description: Editor schema reference. Validation always uses the schema shipped with the installed Skillex package.

scope.description: Advisory label. Manifest placement determines scope; a mismatch is reported without changing that placement.

inherit_global.description: Include global selections in a composed project selection; ignored globally and while a set exclusively replaces the project root. This does not choose write scopes and cannot suppress client-level discovery of the global root.

registry.description: Repository identity used to locate an existing local registry cache. It never triggers cloning, fetching, or network access.

skills.description: Explicit canonical all-skills/ references applied after inheritance in a composed selection; rejected while a set exclusively replaces the root (enable derives a scope-owned set instead).

sets.description: Sets are mutually exclusive root replacements: selecting one replaces .agents/skills/ with a symlink to the set's skill root and replaces inherited global selection. At most one set per scope.

optional.description: Report an unavailable set as an optional skip instead of a required-reference failure.

packs.description: Packs are composable: each adds its member per-skill links to the existing canonical root, alongside any selected skills.

anyOf.description: Pack name, optionally followed by @VERSION. An omitted version selects the latest available local version.

optional.description: Report an unavailable pack as an optional skip; its members are simply not contributed.

exclude.description: Mask names after inheritance, packs, and explicit skills in a composed selection; unsupported while a set exclusively replaces the root.
